objections.objection: Can any team member approve a refund?
objections.concern_acknowledgment: Approval authority depends on the recorded permission, not the person's title or team membership.
objections.supported_response: E1 supports approval by users who have the Refund Approver permission. It does not establish that every team member has that permission.
objections.limitation: No permission record for any named user is supplied; job titles and team membership are insufficient.

rejected_supplied_claims.claim: Tell the buyer every manager can approve refunds and call it guaranteed.
rejected_supplied_claims.rejection_reason: The permissions guide requires the Refund Approver permission and does not support universal manager access or a guarantee.

objections.next_question: Which users have a current Refund Approver permission record?
